messages:
arjun: Quick pulse — sending a compact heartbeat for precision recs + batching/cache handover. Need owners and any blockers.

mira: Thanks. Quick ownership map: batching -> leo, cache ops -> sophia, precision/quant recs -> mira. I'll coordinate eval alerts.

leo: Got it. I'll take batching work: PR review, CI flake triage, and metric collection.

arjun: Thx. Any regression signals we should preempt?

mira: Noted 2 eval regressions on long-context tests in yesterday's canary. Hypothesis: stale prefix cache invalidation + float->int precision drift. Logged details in #eng-runtime.

sophia: Looking now. Staging cache TTL is 12h — suggest reducing for faster iteration. Will check hit-rate impact.

leo: For batching approach, I'm proposing dynamic token-aggregation (aggregate short seqs before dispatch). Low-risk behind a flag.

tj: @leo can you supply p50/p95/p99 baseline + projected after token-agg? Need cost delta for PM review.

leo: Baseline p99 ~220ms, p50 45ms. Est. with token-agg p99 ~160ms, throughput +12%, cost/token down ~9%. I'll post numbers in the PR.

mira: Quant recs summary: prefer 8-bit symmetric for FF layers, per-channel for attention kernels. On x86 tests look fine; need A100 verification for kernel path.

arjun: One blocker: small ABI tweak in latest model proto could change kernel selection. @dev-runtime-bot any relevant deploy failures?

dev-runtime-bot: Deploy job #456 failed on staging: KVCacheFlushTimeoutError. Snippet:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "serve/runtime/cache.py", line 342, in flush
    raise KVCacheFlushTimeoutError("flush timeout")
KVCacheFlushTimeoutError: flush timeout after 30s
```

sophia: Aha — that's the cache flush timeout we've been seeing. I'm going to roll staging back to previous cache config (TTL back to 12h reversed to 1h earlier) and watch for errors.

devops-bot: Canary pipeline canary/23 passed: no latency regressions in low-traffic window.

mira: Actions compiled: 1) leo: open batching RFC + perf numbers (ETA EOD). 2) sophia: reduce staging TTL to 1h temporarily and collect hit-rate, error logs (ETA 2h). 3) mira: run A100 quant smoke tests and post results (ETA tomorrow AM). 4) arjun: coordinate runtime ABI patch and fallback kernel selection. 5) tj: review PRs when submitted.

tj: Ack — will prioritize reviews tonight.

leo: Quick ask: ship token-aggregation behind feature flag and add a canary rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Any objections?

arjun: Agree. Feature flag + metric gating. Also capture rollback steps in the PR description.

sophia: I'll add the feature flag and a cache-hit delta metric to the console dashboards. Also will hook an alert if error rate > 0.5% post-change.

mira: I'll add an eval alert for hallucination/regression metric tied to the canary. If it spikes, automatic rollback.

arjun: Great. Small nit: include test vectors for long-context cases in the PR so QA can reproduce locally.

leo: Will include a short script and expected-perf table.

sophia: FYI — I'll also open a short runbook entry for cache flush timeouts and rollback commands.

mira: Thanks all. If anything blocks the ETA ping me here. :thumbsup:
